from solution import max_Abs_Diff


def test_issue_example_from_issue():
    """Maximum difference between any two elements in (2,1,5,3) is 4."""
    assert max_Abs_Diff((2, 1, 5, 3), 4) == 4  # 5-1=4


def test_issue_two_elements():
    """Maximum difference between any two elements in (1,10) is 9."""
    assert max_Abs_Diff((1, 10), 2) == 9  # 10-1=9


def test_issue_all_equal_zero():
    """Maximum difference between any two elements all equal is 0."""
    assert max_Abs_Diff((7, 7, 7, 7), 4) == 0  # 7-7=0


def test_issue_negative_only():
    """Maximum difference between any two elements in (-8,-3,-10) is 7."""
    assert max_Abs_Diff((-8, -3, -10), 3) == 7  # -3-(-10)=7


def test_issue_mixed_signs():
    """Maximum difference between any two elements in (-4,10,-10,5) is 20."""
    assert max_Abs_Diff((-4, 10, -10, 5), 4) == 20  # 10-(-10)=20


def test_issue_sorted_ascending():
    """Maximum difference between any two elements in (1,2,3,4,10) is 9."""
    assert max_Abs_Diff((1, 2, 3, 4, 10), 5) == 9  # 10-1=9


def test_issue_sorted_descending():
    """Maximum difference between any two elements in (10,8,5,1) is 9."""
    assert max_Abs_Diff((10, 8, 5, 1), 4) == 9  # 10-1=9


def test_issue_single_element():
    """Maximum difference between any two elements with one element is 0."""
    assert max_Abs_Diff((42,), 1) == 0  # 42-42=0


def test_issue_list_input():
    """Maximum difference between any two elements in [3,1,9,4] is 8."""
    assert max_Abs_Diff([3, 1, 9, 4], 4) == 8  # 9-1=8


def test_contract_result_is_absolute_nonnegative():
    """Name max_Abs_Diff means absolute difference is never negative."""
    assert max_Abs_Diff((10, 4), 2) == 6  # 10-4=6, hence >=0


def test_contract_repeated_calls_stable():
    """Calling max_Abs_Diff(arr, n) twice gives the same maximum difference."""
    first = max_Abs_Diff((4, 1, 9), 3)
    second = max_Abs_Diff((4, 1, 9), 3)
    assert first == second == 8  # 9-1=8
